caption: The drawing depicts a doorway composed of two vertically aligned iron doors, each door divided into three main rectangular panels: two top and middle panels featuring intricate, symmetrical, floral and geometric ironwork designs, and one bottom plain panel. The ironwork is highlighted in a light brown color, while the outlines and details are rendered in black ink. The doors are framed by two tall, rectangular stone columns with simple bases and capitals that flank each side, supporting a lintel with classical molding and volute details at the top corners. The steps leading up to the door are shaded with lines and a patch of brown, while the background shows partial brickwork details along the edges. The label "IRON DOORWAY" is written below the image.
title: Wrought and Cast Iron Doorway
